title: Kedai Baru, Pelanggan Berbulu
genre: Malay neo-soul (Rhodes and live bass, ALYPH 'Ingat' lane)
subject: a woman in her first week running a tiny second-hand book shop in Ipoh where no customer comes in, only a ginger stray cat that sleeps on the cash book every afternoon at three
caption: Malay neo-soul in the mellow Southeast Asian R&B-soul style. Fender Rhodes with tremolo playing extended chords, fingerstyle electric bass walking melodic lines, laid-back live drums with ghost-note snare, muted trumpet answering the vocal, clean jazz guitar comping. Soft analog-warm mix with light tape saturation and roomy drums. Female alto, close-miked, singing unhurried and behind the beat. 84 BPM, Db major. Warm, wry and hopeful. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no rap verse, no EDM synths, no ballad power-chorus.
lyrics:
[Intro - Rhodes and muted trumpet]

[Verse 1]
Pintu kaca aku lap pagi-pagi
Rak buku lama tersusun rapi
Loceng pintu diam seharian
Cuma kipas yang berbunyi

[Chorus]
Pukul tiga dia datang
Kucing oren tanpa nama
Tidur atas buku tunai
Satu-satunya pelanggan aku

[Verse 2]
Jualan hari ni: kosong
Dia tolak pen aku ke lantai
Mata separuh, ekor bergoyang
Macam bos yang tak puas hati

[Bridge - bass and drums only]
Sabar, kata mak cik sebelah
Kedai baru memang begini

[Chorus]
Pukul tiga dia datang
Kucing oren tanpa nama
Hari Jumaat dia bawa kawan
Budak sekolah cari novel lama

[Outro - Rhodes and trumpet fade]
